fields.description:
Discovered during the 2026-09-05 memory-exhaustion incident RCA (parent: 2ab6-bae5-8ca4-429c / trashy-deathless-jabiru). Distinct from 9ea3-7d07-ea55-4496 (remote MCP endpoint 502/OOM): this is the LOCAL macOS dev host.

Evidence (shutdown_stall spindump 2026-09-05 21:51): 20 python3.13 processes, each ~1.1GB footprint, parents = uv wrapper processes, spawned in pairs/quads at distinct session epochs over 5+ days (fork ages 113k–455k seconds). Each ran ~28 minutes of CPU-visible work then its main thread was never scheduled again (last-ran up to 453,553s before shutdown) — permanently blocked, holding the full Python heap. 11 uv wrappers were likewise blocked >1h. Aggregate ~10.5GB leaked. Pattern re-formed post-reboot: mem-sentinel first sample (2026-09-06 12:27) already showed two ~1.3GB uv-cache pythons.

Hypothesis (verified by RCA 2026-09-06, see comments): uv-launched Serena MCP servers do not exit because the client harness process itself survives orphaned (PPID 1) holding the MCP stdio pipe fds, so EOF never arrives; footprint is ~1.3GB per server because Serena indexed the full 31GB/383k-file checkout.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Reproduce: start an agent-style MCP session via uv, kill the harness, observe whether uv+python pair exits within a bounded time. [DONE 2026-09-06 — bounded experiments in comments: uv+Serena exit within ~3s of stdin EOF or parent death; leak requires an orphaned harness holding the pipes.]
2. Identify the exact process (rebar-mcp vs serena vs gate daemon) via command-line capture. [DONE — Serena MCP servers + pyright chain; NOT rebar-mcp, NOT gate daemons.]
3. Fix the lifecycle so orphaned pairs exit. [DONE — (a) all three harnesses (Copilot ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json, Claude ~/.claude.json, Codex user-level ~/.codex/config.toml) now launch Serena against the read-only ~/.rebar-serena-mirror (~130MB instead of ~1.3GB); tracked .codex/config.toml serena entry removed via Gerrit change 2725, merged as 53d18aad2ab9; (b) ~/rebar/.serena/project.yml explicit ignored_paths; (c) mem-sentinel orphan sweep logs PPID-1 copilot/uv/serena processes and reaps copilot orphans >24h, uv/serena orphans >1h.]
4. One-week soak validation of mem-sentinel logs is split out to follow-up task bdd0-14ef-2973-4902 (feministic-unmetalled-xerus), linked discovered_from — it cannot be observed at close time by construction.
